title: fix: piv_inject_login_impl mutates g_slots/g_keys without g_lock
description:
In wp11_pkcs11.c (inside #ifdef WOLFP11_CFG_TEST), piv_inject_login_impl and related test helpers mutate g_slots[] and g_keys[] without acquiring g_lock. These are the same globals protected by g_lock in all production code paths.

Trigger: Call wp11_test_inject_piv_login concurrently with C_Sign/C_Verify/C_Finalize in a multithreaded test.
Bad behavior: TOCTOU violation — between the slot_id bounds check at line ~805 and the field access at line ~806, C_Finalize can clear g_slots[slot_id], causing the subsequent access to read or write stale/freed memory.

Fix: Acquire g_lock at the start of piv_inject_login_impl and release it at the end, OR require that callers of the test injection API call C_Initialize first (which initializes g_lock) and hold the lock during injection. Add a comment explaining the locking requirement.
